Privacy policy

Frequently asked questions

What sites does JobSift support?

Right now, LinkedIn Jobs only. JobSift does not currently support other job platforms.

Which LinkedIn Jobs search does JobSift support?

JobSift works with LinkedIn’s “Describe the job you want” Jobs search. It does not currently support Saved Jobs, Collections or standalone job-detail pages.

Open LinkedIn Jobs Search
Why is JobSift not working on my LinkedIn Jobs page?

LinkedIn has more than one Jobs search experience. JobSift supports /jobs/search-results/. The separate /jobs/search/ experience is not currently supported.

Open the supported search
Do I need to start a scan manually?

No. On the supported LinkedIn Jobs search, JobSift scans automatically when the results load.

What do the three signals mean?
Promoted
A listing showing a Promoted signal on LinkedIn.
Reposted
A listing showing that it has been reposted on LinkedIn.
100+ applicants
A listing showing a 100+ applicant or apply signal. LinkedIn may show “Over 100 people clicked apply”; this does not establish how many people completed an application.

JobSift identifies these signals. It does not assess whether a job is good, bad or suitable for you.

Can I choose what stays in my results?

Yes. Each filter can be turned on or off, so you decide whether Promoted, Reposted and 100+ applicants listings stay visible.

How can I send feedback?

If you have JobSift installed, open its popup and select Feedback. This opens the external feedback form.

For privacy questions, use the contact listed in the privacy policy.
